name: Python Runtime
description: Base interpreter used to create isolated environments for the Python physics labs.
notes: Physical Lab scans python.org Framework installs, Homebrew, PATH, Conda environments and module virtual environments.

name: Conda / Miniforge
description: Optional environment manager used to discover and preserve specialized runtimes such as the existing PyChrono environment.
notes: Physical Lab checks Miniforge, Miniconda, Anaconda and PATH. Current physics Labs do not require Conda when their normal venvs work.

name: Node.js + npm
description: Build-time dependency for compiling the Physical Lab Tauri desktop shell from source. Not required after a packaged app is installed.
notes: The build script can use Homebrew to install Node when available; packaged users do not need Node.

name: Rust / Cargo / rustup
description: Build-time Rust toolchain used to compile the Tauri macOS shell and Universal2 targets.
notes: Physical Lab checks cargo, rustc, rustup and the arm64/x86_64 Apple targets. Packaged users do not need Rust.

name: NumPy
description: Array and numerical foundation used across the computational-physics labs.
notes: Ordinary dependency. Physical Lab searches every discovered Python environment and each installed Lab venv.

name: SciPy
description: Scientific algorithms, integration, optimization and special functions.
notes: Ordinary dependency; automatically installed per Lab when required.

name: pandas
description: Tabular result handling and export support.
notes: Ordinary dependency; automatically installed per Lab when required.

name: Plotly
description: Interactive scientific visualization used by several Streamlit labs.
notes: Ordinary dependency; automatically installed per Lab when required.

name: Streamlit
description: Embedded local web UI runtime for the current Lab interfaces.
notes: Ordinary dependency; each Lab keeps its own compatible version.

name: Matplotlib
description: Scientific plotting backend used by Random Walk and accelerator-physics tools.
notes: Ordinary dependency; automatically installed per Lab when required.

name: h5py
description: HDF5 import/export support for field maps and research packages.
notes: Ordinary dependency; automatically installed per Lab when required.

name: mpmath
description: High-precision numerical references and special-function support.
notes: Ordinary pure-Python dependency.

name: Xcode Command Line Tools
description: Apple compiler and SDK toolchain used by native scientific builders.
notes: The health check verifies xcode-select plus clang, clang++, make, lipo, otool, install_name_tool and xcrun.

name: Native Build Toolchain
description: Command-line tools used by RADIA, Chrono::Modal and VAMPIRE builders.
notes: Checks git, curl, make, clang/clang++, ar, ranlib, lipo, shasum, tar, xcrun, file, ditto, zip, otool and install_name_tool individually and reports their resolved paths.

name: CMake
description: Required when building Chrono::Modal from source.
notes: Physical Lab scans PATH, Homebrew and Conda environments before showing a download reminder.

name: FFTW
description: Native FFT library built as part of the verified RADIA runtime workflow.
notes: Physical Lab checks common RADIA/FFTW output locations; the integrated RADIA builder can recreate it.

name: RADIA Runtime
description: Native magnetic-field engine used by Full mode in the accelerator-physics Labs.
notes: Physical Lab searches environment variables and common RADIA directories, then validates CPython ABI and a real import smoke test.

name: PyChrono
description: Python interface for Project Chrono.
notes: Physical Lab scans Conda environments and reports optional module availability instead of assuming one global Python.

name: Chrono::Modal Universal2 SDK
description: Optional C++ modal-analysis SDK.
notes: Existing packaged SDK outputs are reused before any rebuild.

name: VAMPIRE Atomistic Runtime
description: Optional atomistic magnetism engine.
notes: Existing Apple-Silicon installs are reused before invoking the integrated builder.
